checkpoint_wrapper_module: wrap a PyTorch nn.Module with activation checkpointing to save GPU memory during training
split_non_tensors_tuple: split a tuple of mixed tensors and non-tensors into separate tensor and non-tensor groups
pack_kwargs_args: pack positional and keyword arguments into flat tuples for autograd checkpoint compatibility
disable_checkpointing_context: use a context manager to temporarily disable activation checkpointing in a code block
patch_batchnorm_hooks: patch batch norm layers in a module to correctly track running stats during checkpointing
